facts.fact: DatacenterDynamics reported in August 2023 that Moroccan operator N+One Datacenters has existing campuses in Morocco and an existing portfolio of digital infrastructure assets it contributes to a new data centre and cloud services platform backed by AIIM; no tier rating is stated.

note: Investment record; the only operating statement is N+One's existing Moroccan campuses. The $90m, 40MW target and expansion are announced, not facts.
